name: Merge queue: private repositories on GitHub Free

attrs.quote: Pull request merge queues are available in any public repository owned by an organization, or in private repositories owned by organizations using GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
attrs.scope: private repositories, GitHub Free for organizations: not available (GitHub Enterprise Cloud only)
attrs.note: Denied by exclusion from the quoted list: private repositories are named only for organizations using GitHub Enterprise Cloud. The quote does not name GitHub Free.
